objective: Replace the syntactic catalog of exact-rank quadratic pair features by a canonical structural basis for the degree-2 column space modulo the affine degree-1 columns.
frozen_from_prior: degree-2 feature definition as all observed rank-specific pair products
basis_rule: Construct the degree-2 incidence matrix without outcome labels.
Order columns so affine/linear columns have pivot priority over quadratic columns.
Retain exactly the quadratic pivot columns that extend the affine column span.
Then use outcomes only to verify that all affine columns plus this structural quadratic quotient basis preserve exact decoder consistency.
anti_circularity: Outcome labels do not select the interaction basis.
The basis spans the full observed degree-2 structural feature space modulo degree one, not merely a fitted subset for W/D/L.
The three case definitions and basis ordering are frozen before qualification.
falsifiers: If quadratic pivot count differs from rank(DEGREE2)-rank(DEGREE1), the proposed basis extraction is mechanically invalid.
If the reduced structural basis loses decoder consistency, the extraction is invalid.
A small quotient basis does not yet prove a closed-form invariant or minimal value-specific pair set.
